messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.00160 can be constructed by placing 12 points as two interleaved regular hexagons (one rotated 30 degrees relative to the other, with slightly different radii) centered at (0.5, 0.5), with the 13th point at the center. This configuration, analogous to a 13-point packing on a disk, balances rotational symmetry with radial perturbation to prevent aligned collinear triples and maximize the smallest triangle area."}
